doc.title: Carl Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Atlanta, Georgia, January 4, 2013

title: Closing thanks
summary: The tape ends with thanks and good wishes for Allen's clinic the next day.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: All right. Well we used up the tape here. I thoroughly enjoyed this.
You are well thought of, and well spoken.
And I think your students at Juilliard are blessed to have you.
Good luck with your clinic tomorrow.
I’m looking forward to it, it should be fun.
